claims.claim: Battery life is excellent, easily lasting all day and among the best on any flagship phone this year.

evidence.evidence_text: Battery life is another big highlight with this phone. It easily lasts me all day and has been probably the best battery life I've experienced on any flagship phone this year.

claims.claim: Camera system shows more noise than Apple and Google flagships in challenging light, but the 50 MP 5X telephoto is clearly better than iPhone's 12 MP sensor in low light.

evidence.evidence_text: Overall, I'd say the camera, especially in more challenging lighting scenarios, does seem to show a bit more noise than the other two smartphones I've compared it to from Apple and Google.
S25 Ultra's 50 megapixel 5X is clearly better than the iPhone's 12 megapixel sensor in my testing, especially in low light.

claims.claim: One UI 7 software feels like a fresh coat of paint with useful new features like Now Bar and lock screen widgets, though lock screen widget support lags behind iPhone.

evidence.evidence_text: Samsung launched One UI 7, which feels like a fresh coat of paint on the software without completely changing everything
the only downside to the lock screen widgets so far compared to on the iPhone is that Apple just has way more apps available that support them compared to Samsung even 6 months later.

claims.claim: S Pen has limited utility; Bluetooth removal and phone wobble make it less useful, and the reviewer questions whether it should be kept.

evidence.evidence_text: the company removed Bluetooth from it, which means it can't do features like air actions or remote camera shutter like in the past.
I still at the same time question how many users of this phone consistently use the S Pen and whether it would just be better to remove it altogether

claims.claim: Gemini Assistant is a highlight with more capabilities than Google Assistant, though it is slower for some tasks and cannot play Apple Music.

evidence.evidence_text: Gemini has not only gotten better than the Google Assistant in most cases. Although, except maybe for speed when doing something like playing music, it's probably still a bit slower

claims.claim: Display is excellent with anti-glare coating and 2600 nits brightness, but 480 Hz PWM is lower than some competitors.

evidence.evidence_text: The display is excellent with that anti-glare coating and 2,600 nits of max brightness, which is impressive.
the only downside is that the PWM is 480 hertz, which is considerably lower than other smartphones like those from Chinese manufacturers

limitations: Reviewer's usage is light to moderate; battery results may differ for heavy users

claims.claim: The S25 Ultra plays it safe with only a spec bump and lacks several expected flagship features.

evidence.evidence_text: They have just played it incredibly safe with this phone. They just took last year's award-winning flagship phone and did the bare minimum, a spec bump.
It also doesn't have IP69, it doesn't add Qi2 magnets, it doesn't bring back the 10x zoom, or even add high frequency PWM dimming.

claims.claim: Performance with the Snapdragon 8 Elite chip is excellent, smooth, and efficient.

evidence.evidence_text: The phone is fast as hell. It benchmarks crazy high, rivaling Apple's A18 Pro chip.
using this phone, it's just so smooth, it's smoother and more efficient than ever before.

claims.claim: The S Pen lost Bluetooth functionality, removing remote control features, which is a downgrade for an 'Ultra' device.

evidence.evidence_text: Samsung removed the Bluetooth functionality from the S Pen, which means it can no longer be used as a remote control shutter for the camera or for any of the media playback controls.
they took a feature away and the justification was, 'Well the data shows that people didn't really use it.'

claims.claim: The 50MP ultra-wide camera is a genuine upgrade, producing sharper and more usable images.

evidence.evidence_text: the new 50 megapixel ultra wide camera? That's also, it's been a genuinely nice upgrade.
all of my ultra wide shots now are much sharper corner to corner. And in darker light, the better sensor gathers more light and gives more usable images consistently.

claims.claim: Battery life is very good, often ending days with 30-40% remaining, but charging is only slightly faster.

evidence.evidence_text: battery life has been awesome on this phone. I've ended days with 30, 40% left, but it's not the best.
the battery does seem to charge a little bit faster, not a lot faster, but a little bit faster.

claims.claim: The phone is good but misses the opportunity to be the best, especially given its $1,299 price.

evidence.evidence_text: this S25 Ultra, is awesome, but it's missed out on an opportunity to be the best. And I think for 1,299 bucks it's fair to expect the best.
To this year saying, 'You could buy anything else.'
